exchangeFormat: OH: RST + OH county (official 4-letter code, e.g. CUYA). Non-OH W/VE (incl KH6/KL7): RST + state/province (2-letter; DC→MD). DX: RST + 'DX'. Bands 160-10m. CW/SSB only. OH works everyone; non-OH works OH only.

scoringRules.scoreFormula: Σ QSO pts × Σ mults (each counted ONCE PER MODE — same mult on CW and SSB = 2 mults). Pts: SSB 1, CW 2. OH entrant mult = 88 OH counties + 49 US states (excl OH, DC→MD) + 11 Canadian provinces + 1 DX (single, any non-W/VE) = 149/mode. Non-OH entrant mult = 88 OH counties (176 max, 88/mode). OH works everyone; non-OH scores OH contacts only. Mobile/rover county/area-change = new QSO + new multiplier; mobile/rover final = QSO pts × unique mults from all activated counties (= the normal mult union). Official OhQP 4-letter county codes bundled (oh.json) and enforced by-exclusion (state/prov are 2-letter, DX literal). Claimed/running — the Mad River RC OhQP committee re-adjudicates. NOT applied (category): power/operator categories. Note: NU/YT/NWT collapse to the official 'NT' token and DC→'MD' per the sender's official-abbreviation responsibility (logged token counted as-is).
